synopsis: What is it? / The jungle denies us our passage. / What have we done? / We? No. I. / What's that mean? / How're we supposed to get through that? / Making an appearance? / I am. / I thought you'd left for good. / Our choices are few. / This is as much for you as it is me. / You are ill at ease. / The nethicite troubles you? / You've let your eyes betray your heart. / Right. / What are you doing? / Soon you will learn. / We go to seek aid of the viera who dwell ahead. / I bet they'll be glad to see you after so long. / I am unwelcome. An unsought guest in their wood.
plays_when: In The Needlebrake (Golmore Jungle), when the party walks into an event area (the script's VieraEventTrigger), which the map places with the story counter from 1640 (After the legend of Giruvegan) and below 1700 (After Lente's Tear) (gol_a02 lines 1431 and 1433): the preload reads the scene on arrival with the counter below 1700 (After Lente's Tear) (lines 983 and 986) and the area then starts it (line 1472), and it holds (gol_a0200 line 33) until the area's touch releases it (gol_a02 lines 1013 and 1539); the touch then waits for the scene's end (line 1540) and sets the story counter to 1700 (After Lente's Tear) (line 1542). Before the release the touch has no return; its break (line 1498) only ends a case of the switch at line 1493.

plays_when: in Dell of the Dreamer (Golmore Jungle), when the party arrives while the Elder Wyrm is undefeated (the battle byte, global byte 0xA11, is 1 from the new game, pre_z0000 line 356, until the win): The Elder Wyrm appears and the battle begins (gol_c01 lines 413 and 417 under the test at line 407). plays_when: in Dell of the Dreamer (Golmore Jungle), when The Elder Wyrm is defeated: the script starts it on arrival together with the opening scene (gol_c01 lines 415 and 418 under the test at line 407), and it holds (gol_c0101 line 57) until the script releases it after the win (gol_c01 line 494), and the win sets the battle byte (global byte 0xA11) to 2 (gol_c01 line 660), so neither scene plays again.
